To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the c.239T > A variant is a novel missense mutation and the p.Val79Asp variant is a novel loss-of-function mutation in the TMPRSS gene.

we identified two novel variants of TMPRSS15 gene in the proband with enterokinase deficiency, and functional analysis revealed that the c.239T > A variant decreased the enterokinase enzyme activity and the c.192G > A variant caused exon 16 skipping.

we identified a Chinese patient with novel compound TMPRSS15 gene variants that caused enterokinase deficiency, and that the functional studies in vitro demonstrated that c.1920G > A and p.Val799Asb variants lead to a decreased protein expression and enzyme activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the pathogenesis of EKD.
the molecular basis and pathogenesis of EKD.
the molecular mechanism and functional characterization of novel TMPRSS15 variants, and provides a reference for genetic counseling and prenatal diagnosis of EKD.
